title: DEMO — Two-car crash, Caraway Rd & Highland Dr
location: Caraway Rd & Highland Dr, Jonesboro AR
notes:
[12:20 PM] Arrived on scene around 4:10 pm. Two vehicles in the intersection, a silver Honda Civic and a blue Ford F-150. Light rain, road wet.
[12:20 PM] Driver of the Civic, adult female, says the light was green for her and the truck turned left in front of her. She complained of neck pain, EMS checked her on scene and she declined transport.
[12:20 PM] Driver of the F-150, adult male, says he thought he had a green arrow. No injuries reported. Front left of the Civic heavily damaged, front right of the truck damaged.
[12:20 PM] One witness at the gas station says the truck turned on a solid green, not an arrow. Got her phone number. Tow requested for the Civic.

result.summary: I responded to a two-vehicle crash at Caraway Rd & Highland Dr in Jonesboro, AR, involving a silver Honda Civic and a blue Ford F-150. The drivers gave conflicting accounts of the traffic signal, and the Civic driver complained of neck pain but declined transport.
result.narrative:
I arrived on scene at approximately 4:10 PM. I observed two vehicles in the intersection, a silver Honda Civic and a blue Ford F-150. There was light rain and the road was wet.

The driver of the Civic, an adult female, stated the light was green for her and the F-150 turned left in front of her. She complained of neck pain. EMS checked her on scene and she declined transport. I observed heavy damage to the front left of the Civic.

The driver of the F-150, an adult male, stated he thought he had a green arrow. He reported no injuries. I observed damage to the front right of the F-150.

I spoke with one witness who was at the gas station. Witness 1 (Sample Witness), whose statement was translated from Spanish, stated the blue truck turned left on a green light, not on a green arrow. I obtained the witness's phone number. I requested a tow for the Civic.

Using Spanish translation, I asked whether anyone was hurt and whether an ambulance was needed. The Spanish-speaking person responded, as translated, "No, I'm fine, but my neck hurts a little." I completed the scene safety and injury/EMS/tow checklist items for a traffic crash.
